core_style.default_register: casual — often uses humor to diffuse tension
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently combines thoughts for emphasis
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick to respond with quips or observations
core_style.two_registers: drops into a more serious tone when discussing family matters — casual with friends, serious with family

humor.style: deflecting — uses humor to avoid deeper emotional discussions
humor.frequency: constant — especially when feeling uncomfortable or challenged
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a serious statement only to twist it with humor

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people or things humorously, revealing a playful dominance in social interactions
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct — uses blunt statements when vulnerable
structural_patterns: refers to himself in the third person as 'Jay' when discussing achievements
begins motivational statements with 'Here's the deal,'
ends challenges with 'Are you ready for this?'

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: uses ellipses and pauses to emphasize thoughts

worldview.value of emotional restraint: believes showing emotion is a weakness — contrasts with characters who embrace vulnerability
worldview.importance of family legacy: values leaving a mark through his children — differs from characters who prioritize personal achievement

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a tough, no-nonsense dad
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often overcompensates for insecurities about his age and parenting skills — shown through his defensiveness
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes sarcastic or dismissive when confronted with his vulnerabilities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses humor and sarcasm to deflect deeper feelings — presents a tough exterior
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented — shows signs of anxiety through abrupt comments
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, blunt statements — avoids elaboration
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confidently asserts opinions and jokes — uses humor to establish dominance

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially uses banter to deflect, but if that fails, he becomes defensive or confrontational
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and humor — rarely backs down
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes serious and direct — prioritizes their safety over humor
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: redirects the conversation or doubles down on his stance — rarely admits fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to sarcasm, then becomes defensive if challenged — triggered by perceived threats to his authority or competence

relationship_matrix.GLORIA: emotional support and partnership — he wants her to understand him
relationship_matrix.MANNY: protective father figure — he wants to guide him while maintaining authority

expert: fatherhood — speaks with authority on parenting
surface: sports — references but doesn't deeply analyze
ignorant: modern technology — often shows confusion or disinterest

social_positioning.desired_position: seen as a strong, capable father figure
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others see him as humorous but sometimes out of touch — power dynamics shift with family
social_positioning.contradiction: wants to be respected but often undermines himself with humor, leading to misunderstandings
